info.title: agent-computer control API
info.description: Development control API: static validation, revocable service credentials, independent runtime grants, authorized definition plans, atomic apply and durable coordination progress. Computer runtime admission, OIDC and execution remain unsupported.

200.description: Database connectivity and exact migration checksums are ready.

post.description: Authenticated, side-effect-free static JSON validation. Requires definitions.validate. No resources are applied. Body limit 1 MiB. Browser Origin and content encoding are rejected. This query does not require an Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Static validation report; this does not grant authority.

post.description: Create/retry an immutable diff and impact plan. Writes only the plan, receipt and event/Outbox; no resource definitions or runtime effects. Existing root metadata and each existing resource require expectedRevision. Requires definitions.manage and current definition/reference grants. Browser Origin is rejected.

get.description: Inspect the authenticated principal own effective permissions. Requires runtime.read and an exact read grant on this target. Organization and principal are derived solely from the service credential. Browser Origin is rejected. The response grants no future execution authority.

200.description: Current effective permissions for the authenticated principal.

400.description: Invalid target kind or resource ID.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, revoked or disabled credential.

403.description: Missing runtime.read scope or unsupported browser Origin.

404.description: Resource is missing, disabled, in another organization, or lacks the caller read grant.

PlannedResource.description: Resolved before/after resource spec, stable ID and immutable dependency versions. Name and expectedRevision are metadata outside the spec. requires_drain is a reconciliation requirement; no runtime transition has occurred.

DefinitionPlan.description: Immutable caller-owned plan; at most 8 MiB serialized, valid for first apply for 15 minutes by database clock. Missing declarations never delete existing data. Returned principal/organization come from authentication, not client input.

DefinitionOperation.description: Current operation metadata and per-intent progress from one organization-locked snapshot. event_sequence is the publication event; watermark is the observation stream position. Apply creates Queued/Pending metadata. Trusted coordination APIs can advance it, but this release has no runtime backend worker; database fixtures do not certify runtime success.

IntentProgress.description: Durable coordination status. attempts is the monotonically increasing coordinator lease epoch, not runtime generation. dispatch_started means an external effect may have occurred; it is not proof of execution or process termination.

RuntimeAccess.description: Current caller grants intersected with this credential scopes. This is informational, not a reusable permit, lease, budget reservation or runtime readiness statement. No inheritance across permissions, resources or related objects.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Exactly one header. Scoped to authenticated organization, principal and operation. Reusing a key with changed input returns 409; retired receipts return 410. Retry unknown outcomes with the same key and input.
